?? Junior Software Developer / IT Support – Entry Level
?? Location: Freehold, NJ (Candidates must reside within a 15-minute commute) ?? Job Type: Full-Time / Part-Time / Entry-Level ?? Eligibility: Students, CPT/OPT, H4 EAD, Recent Graduates

We are seeking students, recent graduates, and entry-level IT candidates who are motivated and eager to start or grow their careers in technology. This role is ideal for individuals looking to gain hands-on, real-world IT and software development experience in a supportive environment.

?? Key Responsibilities

Provide basic IT support and troubleshooting (hardware/software issues)
Assist in software development projects (based on skillset)
Work with technologies like Java, Python, SQL, or web development tools
Perform data entry, testing, and debugging tasks
Support internal teams with technical documentation and system updates
Collaborate with senior developers and IT staff


??? Required Skills

Basic knowledge of at least one: Java / Python / JavaScript / SQL
Understanding of computer systems, networking basics, or databases
Strong problem-solving and communication skills
Willingness to learn and adapt quickly


?? Preferred Qualifications

Currently pursuing or completed a degree in Computer Science / IT / Engineering

Familiarity with tools like Git, Excel, or cloud platforms is a plus


?? Additional Requirements


Must live within 15 minutes of Freehold, NJ
Must have valid work authorization (Student eligibility, OPT / CPT / H4 EAD)
